# Vendored browser assets

These pinned assets are included locally so the app shell keeps its icons and charts offline:

- `tabler-icons/2.44.0/`: Tabler Icons Webfont CSS and WOFF2 from `@tabler/icons-webfont@2.44.0` (MIT; see its `LICENSE`).
- `chart.js/4.4.1/`: Chart.js UMD bundle from `Chart.js` v4.4.1 (MIT; see `LICENSE.md`).

When updating either dependency, keep page references, these files, license text, and `sw.js` precache entries in sync.
